ops.body:
**Answered yes** by the owner in person (Nov 14, during the T29 review; decision 0170): "All in words", the
  recommended shape: the memory preview "and two more here"; the walks row's captures T19's clause, built with T19
  since they share `formatCaptures`; a delete's confirm "Its trace, three moments and twelve streets walked go." and
  "Two photos and a voice memo go." Waits for the next `/tend inbox`, one build per run (T29 was built first).

argv: The walk screen and the recording bar announce the count of the reminders
fixed by tend explore audit 6: the announcements say the card's own title for all it holds
Three more tables of the kinds' words
ops.body: - [loop] Every table of the kinds' words outside `lib/pins.ts` (`pinKindsWords`, `KIND_NAME`, which the reminders take since `tend explore T29`): `resurface/context.ts` `KIND` ("just after a photo"), `lib/format.ts` `formatCaptures` (T19 and T30 change its words), `deletion/core.ts` `KIND_NOUN` and `mediaRemoveText`'s nouns, `lib/captureBand.ts` l.10 `KIND_NAME`, `journal/lines.ts` l.70, `gallery/copy.ts` l.38, `components/chronicle/MomentCard.tsx` l.16, `components/threads/MomentPicker.tsx` l.13, `ResponseEntry.tsx` l.11, `AddToThread.tsx` l.16 and `NoteText.tsx` l.14, `notePage/useMentionCards.ts` l.9 and `space/core.ts` l.72 (lowercase); the same words today, so a later change can split them (cleanup, the T29 sibling lens and its review's auditor 2; low)

- [loop] After a reload with a walk open, a reminder that fires with the walk minimized can show nowhere: the walk screen (mounted as the app opens, NR3) and the recording bar both register with `onRecallFired`, which holds one listener, so whichever registered last takes the fire; when it is the walk screen, no card, no bar line and no notification show, and a "once" flag is spent. Seen in three of four runs of the memories journey's audit 7 step, once on main's build at `decae354` and twice on the `tend explore audit 7` build; the one run where the bar had it fired at the first fix after the reload (each time both flags consumed; no `[data-testid=reminder]`, no `recording-reminder`, no notification, on `/`); the step logs it and checks the bar's words only when the bar has the fire. The fix is likely a stack of listeners, as `onRecallOpen` has (`lib/openers.ts`), the screen in front first (`discovery/recallCheck.ts` l.60-71; the T29 review; medium)

- [owner] Long reminder words are cut on the card: at 320 px its one-line title (about 180 px of text beside the clock and ✕) cuts from about "Thirteen memories here" on ("Twenty-seven memori…"), the count's first word kept; a body of four kinds in words ("Twenty-seven photos, twenty-three videos, thirty-four voice memos and twenty-eight notes", 87 characters) reaches its two lines and ends in an ellipsis at 390 px too. The full words stay in the card's name and the notification; the minimized bar's line fitted "Two memories here" at 320 with about 90 px to spare in the one run where the bar had the fire (that picture was not kept; longer counts not pictured). Yours: accept the cut, or two lines for the title against the no-wrap rule (`ReminderCard.tsx` l.36-37, `numberOfLines` 1 and 2; WCAG 1.4.10; the T29 review's ux 1 and ux 6, low)

- [loop] The recording bar's reminder of several says "Two memories here. Return to the walk to see it": "them" fits several, with the words in `lib/recordingBar` (core) beside the bar's others (`RecordingBar.tsx` l.196; the T29 review's ux 4, opinion; low)

- [loop] A note's reminder card names itself with two full stops, "A note from here: The bakery smelled of cardamom.. Open" (`ReminderCard.tsx` l.26 puts ". Open" after a body that ends its own sentence); a core `reminderName` in `discovery/recall.ts` would drop the second (the T29 review's ux 5; low)

argv: since `tend explore T29` (decision 0164), set Remind me here
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** since `tend explore T29` (decision 0164), set Remind me here on a photo, a note and a voice memo kept in that order at one spot; on a later walk pass the spot with the walk screen in front and VoiceOver, then TalkBack, on; again with the walk minimized; again with the app in the background. **Expect:** one card "Three memories here", its body "A photo, a note and a voice memo", announced "Three memories here"; minimized, the recording bar's line and its announcement say the same; in the background, one notification with that title and body; no digits anywhere; a reminder of one note announced "A note from here", as its card says (`reminderText`, `reminderHeld`, `tend explore audit 6`).

- **v1-discovery R7's example after T29** (Nov 14; decision 0164): since `tend explore T29` two or more reminders in
  reach show as one card that says its count in words, "Two memories here" (`numberWord`; "Many memories here" past
  fifty-nine), its body the pins' words for its kinds in the order taken ("A voice memo and two photos",
  `pinKindsWords`), the same on the card, in the notification and in the announcements of the walk screen and the
  recording bar. Amend, in the doc and its mirror (the loop may not edit a spec): `specs/v1-discovery/spec.md` l.211,
  R7's "Two reminders in reach show as one: "2 memories here"". No rule line said the old words, and none says the
  new: `.claude/rules/explore-and-discovery.md`, which holds "Remind me here", is at 39,957 of the 40,000 characters
  `check:docs` allows, so the loop could add no line; a split of it into two files is yours (the loop changes no
  line it did not write). Until then the words are in `reminderText`'s and `reminderHeld`'s comments (since `tend explore audit 6` the announcements say the card's own title, for all it holds).

**Nov 14, `/tend inbox T29 yes`** (from `a181030d`, rebased on `decae354`; the owner's own answer, in person, Nov 13,
decision 0164; T19, T20 and T21, answered in decision 0165, wait for later runs, one build per run).
- `tend explore T29`: a reminder of several says its count in words, "Two memories here" ("Many memories here" past
  fifty-nine), and its body the pins' words for its kinds in the order taken ("A video and a photo"), from one table
  (`pinKindsWords`, `KIND_NAME` in `lib/pins.ts`); recall's second copy is gone. The card, the notification, the
  recording bar's line and both announcements say it. When and whether a reminder or its notification shows is
  unchanged; "What happened here" keeps "12 min in". Sibling lens: built on the reminders and their announcements;
  filed as T30 the memory preview's "2 more here", the walks row's "1 photo · 1 video" and a delete's "3 moments";
  Chronicle's Memories already says its counts in words.
The review's fixes (one round of the auditor and the ux-reviewer, decision 0145):
- `tend explore audit 5`: the reminder's tests build their moments in local time, so they pass in every zone (R4's
  test failed east of UTC+9 since slice 4); the tie order, a hyphenated count and "Many" over a counted body pinned
  (auditor 1).
- `tend explore audit 6`: the walk screen and the recording bar announce the card's own title for all it holds
  ("A note from here", "Three memories here"), not the count just due (`reminderHeld`; auditor 3, ux 2, ux 3).
- `tend explore audit 7`: the journey step checks its setup, reads the card once it settles, removes its flags and
  walks back; the minimized bar's line is checked and pictured; "the reminder opens its capture" can fail now
  (auditor 4, auditor 5).
Review: 6 accepted, 1 recorded (auditor 2: the cleanup item names every copy of the kinds' words), 3 deferred (ux 1
with ux 6 `[owner]`, ux 4 and ux 5 `[loop]`), 0 rejected. New on the way: the walk screen and the bar race for the one
reminder listener after a reload (`[loop]` medium, seen in three of four runs of the step). T30 was answered yes by the owner
during the review (decision 0170) and waits for the next `/tend inbox`.
Not a sweep: no lens ran and no area changed state. The memories journey green on the final code; the unit tests
seen failing first (the T29 and audit 6 tests on the code before, audit 5's fixtures under `TZ=Asia/Tokyo`), the
journey's T29 check on main's build. Nothing here has run on a phone (`docs/NATIVE_UNVERIFIED.md`). v1-discovery R7's
example waits for your edit, and `.claude/rules/explore-and-discovery.md` for a split (both under "Open before the
loop").
